intro: The Filled Vessel contains purified waters drawn from the various sacred moonwells across Teldrassil. Entrusted to couriers by Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar, it is delivered to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus to aid his study of the World Tree's ailments.

p: Teldrassil was planted without the blessings of the Great Aspects, Alexstrasza and Nozdormu, leaving its immense boughs vulnerable to unexpected corruption, strange beasts, and crazed furbolg tribes. In an attempt to monitor and cleanse the burgeoning boughs, night elf acolytes are dispatched to gather water samples from moonwells situated across the boughs. Corithras Moonrage consolidates these gathered phials into a single Filled Vessel, sending it onward to the capital. The mixture serves as a vital sample of Teldrassil's vitality for Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm, who works tirelessly in the Cenarion Enclave to uncover a remedy for the Great Tree's pervasive flaws.
